$schema.description: Optional editor schema location. It does not change runtime validation.

items.description: A non-empty repository-relative glob pattern using forward slashes.

includes.description: Optional repository-relative file patterns. Omission inherits the lower-precedence list; an empty array selects no paths.

items.description: A non-empty repository-relative glob pattern using forward slashes.

excludes.description: Additional repository-relative exclusions. Exclusions accumulate across configuration layers and always win.

items.description: A non-empty repository-relative glob pattern using forward slashes.

privacyExcludes.description: Additional protected-path exclusions. These accumulate and cannot be overridden by lower-privacy layers.

credentialEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable that supplies the review credential. Store the secret value outside configuration.

claudeFeedbackMode.description: Claude PostToolUse feedback. Blocking current findings requires an explicit user configuration opt-in; a project may only restrict it to advisory.

packs.description: Local rule-pack path declarations or references to packs inherited from lower-precedence layers. Bundled Noul loads independently.

ruleOverrides.description: Map of qualified rule IDs to layer-specific overrides. Use pack-id/rule-id for local packs.

title: Review configuration v1
description: JSONC configuration for file selection, rule packs, credential references, and whole-file JSON request settings.

deadlineMs.description: Per-file deadline in milliseconds for whole-file JSON requests.

concurrency.description: Maximum concurrently reviewed files for whole-file JSON requests.

adviceBudget.description: Maximum findings delivered for a whole-file JSON request event.

transientRetries.description: Additional retry attempts for transient backend failures in the whole-file JSON request path.

RuntimeSettings.description: Optional whole-file JSON request controls. Omitted layer values inherit; built-in values apply when no layer supplies a value.

anyOf.description: Path to a local rule-pack document.

path.description: Local rule-pack path; relative paths resolve from the originating configuration file.

enabled.description: Optional enablement override. Omission inherits an existing pack's state and enables a newly declared pack.

id.description: Identity of a rule pack declared in a lower-precedence configuration layer.

enabled.description: Optional enablement override. Omission inherits an existing pack's state and enables a newly declared pack.

RulePackReference.description: A path declaration or an inherited pack identity; object forms contain exactly one locator.

enabled.description: Whether this rule is enabled in this configuration layer.

items.description: A non-empty repository-relative glob pattern using forward slashes.

includes.description: Additional rule path filters; they intersect global file selection.

items.description: A non-empty repository-relative glob pattern using forward slashes.

excludes.description: Rule-specific path exclusions; they cannot restore globally excluded paths.

threshold.description: Probability threshold from 0 through 1. Omission inherits the rule-pack threshold.

message.description: Advice text to use for this rule; omission keeps the rule-pack message.

RuleOverride.description: Layer-specific activation, path filters, threshold, and advice message for one qualified rule ID.
